questions.q: Who propounded the theory of operant conditioning?
questions.e: B. F. Skinner developed operant conditioning, in which behaviour is shaped by its consequences. Pavlov is linked with classical conditioning and Bandura with observational learning.

questions.q: In Pavlov's experiment, the sound of the bell before it has been paired with food is a ______ stimulus.
questions.e: Before pairing, the bell produces no salivation, so it is a neutral stimulus. After repeated pairing with food it becomes a conditioned stimulus.

questions.q: The concept of the 'Zone of Proximal Development' was given by
questions.e: Vygotsky defined the ZPD as the gap between what a learner can do alone and what the learner can do with help from a more knowledgeable person.

questions.q: In the revised Bloom's taxonomy (2001), the highest level of the cognitive domain is
questions.e: The 2001 revision places Create at the top, above Evaluate. In the original 1956 version, Evaluation was the highest level.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about reinforcement.
I. Positive reinforcement increases the likelihood of a behaviour by adding a pleasant consequence.
II. Negative reinforcement increases the likelihood of a behaviour by removing an unpleasant stimulus.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both positive and negative reinforcement strengthen behaviour. Negative reinforcement is not punishment, because punishment reduces behaviour.

questions.q: Bandura's Bobo doll experiment showed that children can learn aggressive behaviour through
o: observation and imitation of a model
questions.e: Children who watched an adult model hit the doll imitated the behaviour, which supports observational (social) learning.

questions.q: The heuristic method of teaching, in which the learner is placed in the position of a discoverer, was advocated by
questions.e: H. E. Armstrong promoted the heuristic method in science teaching. Kilpatrick is linked with the project method and Parkhurst with the Dalton Plan.

questions.q: A teacher asks Class IX students to plan, build and evaluate a website on school events over three weeks, each group choosing its own sub-tasks. Which method is mainly being used?
questions.e: A purposeful, student-planned activity carried out over time and ending in a product is the project method.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Gagné's nine events of instruction.
I. Gaining the learners' attention is the first event.
II. Presenting the content comes before informing learners of the objectives.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: The order is: gain attention, inform learners of objectives, stimulate recall of prior learning, then present content. So II is wrong.

questions.q: Which schedule of reinforcement generally produces a high rate of response that is most resistant to extinction?
questions.e: In a variable-ratio schedule the number of responses needed for reward is unpredictable, as in a slot machine. This gives steady, high and persistent responding.
